name: SurveyPlanet Free Surveys
free_limit: Unlimited hosted surveys, questions and responses in the $0 Basic plan, with anonymous surveys, embedding, basic themes and in-app reporting.
watch_out: CSV/Excel export, advanced branching, custom themes and some premium reporting/sharing features require SurveyPlanet Pro. The hosted Free offer is separate from any self-hosted software; payment-card and commercial-use terms are not explicitly confirmed.
